text: Phase-change materials such as GST and GSST enable non-volatile photonic weight storage because, once switched between amorphous and crystalline states, they retain that state indefinitely at ___ power.
explanation: PCM cells hold their amorphous or crystalline phase, and thus their optical state, with no standby power, giving non-volatile analog weight storage of about 5 bits. This is the basis of the Feldmann et al. 2021 photonic tensor-core demonstration.
